description: Curated variant of the F-1.5.2 sim-realism diagnostic: the same synthetic-vs-IAFDB per-feature overlay, but restricted via layout.features to a representative spread across the feature families (amplitude, frequency, complexity) so a paper figure shows only the informative panels. The feature list here is illustrative — replace it with whichever features the realism analysis flags as interesting. Renders via the 'feature-distribution-overlay' recipe.
